newsitem.title: USA: Fleet Financial to acquire Columbia Mgmt.
newsitem.headline: Fleet Financial to acquire Columbia Mgmt.

text.p: Fleet Financial Group said on Thursday that it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire privately owned asset manager Columbia Management Co in a deal that calls for Fleet to pay a $400 million premium.
"Financially, we expect the transaction to be immediately accretive to earnings," said Fleet chief financial officer Eugene McQuade.
"Columbia will add to earnings per share in 1998, with potential to be notably additive as the business grows," he said.
In a statement, Fleet also said the acquisition would broaden its geographic reach and increase fee revenues by 5 percent. Columbia had 1996 revenues of $96 million, it added.
The transaction is expected to close by the end of the year.
